IMPORTANT GAP: at fetch time the Toast page's server-rendered state only carried the Desserts/Cocktails/Wine/Liquor menus (59 priced items, no markup pattern, first-party); the core Pizza/Pasta/Antipasti/Secondi/Sides food menu is confirmed to exist (item names and descriptions visible on the restaurant's own isolapizzabar.com/encinitas static page - "Encinitas Dinner Menu": margherita, salamino piccante, cacio e pepe, etc.) but that page carries NO prices anywhere, and no DoorDash/Uber Eats/Postmates listing specific to this Encinitas address could be found (searches only returned the La Jolla and Little Italy branches or an ambiguous multi-location aggregator page). Dropped "Corckage Fee" (a fee, not a dish) and "Catering" (generic $750 placeholder, not a real menu item). Filed the priced portion; the food-menu section remains unpriced and excluded rather than guessed.

notes: Own website is an Instagram profile behind a login wall (not extractable). Found via Uber Eats; address confirmed exact match ("4738 University Avenue, A", San Diego, CA 92105) via the store's structured address field. 30 priced items across Menu/Smoothies; prices show varied cent-endings (.00/.40/.95/.10/.50/.68/.75/.65/.90/.45/.15) with no uniform-divisor pattern, so no markup evidence. Postmates lists the same items at identical prices (Natural Juices $9.00, Smoothies Classic $8.40, Sandwish $14.00) but Postmates is Uber-owned - not used as an independent crossCheckedAgainst source, only noted as corroboration.
